title: betula pendula var. fontqueri
intro: Betula pendula var. fontqueri, commonly known as a silver birch variety, is a type of deciduous tree native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Betula pendula var. fontqueri include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include betulin, betulol, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
